A public dashboard that tracks the US macro picture as new data is released. The live app currently shows the US Treasury yield curve and ISM Manufacturing signals. Further modules covering credit spreads, ISM Services and commodities are in development.

title: Projects
section: Research: US Jobs Data and European Carbon Prices
text:
Research: US Jobs Data and European Carbon Prices
Python, Excel · October 2026
An exploratory study of whether US employment and industrial activity help explain changes in EU Allowance (EUA) carbon prices, using monthly data from 2013 to mid-2026. It tests monthly relationships; it does not test immediate reactions to jobs announcements.
Tests of total, manufacturing, and mining and logging employment found no consistent relationship with EUA returns, and employment did not consistently add information beyond industrial production measures. One exploratory pattern linked unusual months in US mining, materials and capacity-use data with EUA returns five months later. It was found after trying many alternatives, received only weak support in an earlier period and showed no reliable forecasting ability, so I treat it as a hypothesis rather than a signal.
Main limitations: the US data include later revisions, EUA prices are auction prices rather than executable futures prices, and many indicators and time gaps were tried on limited samples. The natural next step is an announcement-day study using market expectations and first-release data.
Sources: ICAP Allowance Price Explorer; US Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED; Federal Reserve G.17 release; ISM Manufacturing Report on Business.

Equity Valuation: ExxonMobil and HSBC
Excel, Bloomberg Terminal · Oct 2024 – Nov 2024
A full fundamental analysis of two large-cap companies from different sectors, using financial statements, peer data and market pricing sourced through Bloomberg Terminal.
I built DCF and comparable company models in Excel with clearly stated assumptions and sensitivity testing, factoring in the energy transition for ExxonMobil and the interest rate environment for HSBC. The work concluded with an investment recommendation for each company.
